description: About AI VIBEATHON 2026 AI VIBEATHON 2026 is an AI-focused innovation and hackathon event organized by Echo Engineers in collaboration with PromptWars . Join WhatsApp group for updates WhatsApp The event brings together students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to explore the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence and build creative solutions to real-world challenges. Participants will get an opportunity to showcase their problem-solving skills, experiment with modern AI tools, collaborate with talented individuals, and turn their ideas into working prototypes. The event will follow a two-stage format: Online Preliminary Round: Participants will compete in an online challenge designed to test their technical knowledge, creativity, problem-solving skills, and understanding of AI. Offline Grand Finale: Selected teams will participate in an intensive 8-hour hackathon, where they will build and present their innovative solutions. Whether you are an experienced developer or someone passionate about exploring AI, AI VIBEATHON 2026 is your opportunity to learn, create, and compete. Think beyond prompts. Build beyond possibilities.

About AI VIBEATHON 2026

AI VIBEATHON 2026 is an AI-focused innovation and hackathon event organized by Echo Engineers in collaboration with PromptWars.

Join WhatsApp group for updates WhatsApp

The event brings together students, developers, innovators, and technology enthusiasts to explore the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence and build creative solutions to real-world challenges.

Participants will get an opportunity to showcase their problem-solving skills, experiment with modern AI tools, collaborate with talented individuals, and turn their ideas into working prototypes.

The event will follow a two-stage format:

  • Online Preliminary Round: Participants will compete in an online challenge designed to test their technical knowledge, creativity, problem-solving skills, and understanding of AI.
  • Offline Grand Finale: Selected teams will participate in an intensive 8-hour hackathon, where they will build and present their innovative solutions.

Whether you are an experienced developer or someone passionate about exploring AI, AI VIBEATHON 2026 is your opportunity to learn, create, and compete.

Think beyond prompts. Build beyond possibilities.
